bayts.text: My aim with Allah I possess perpetually, by the standing of him whom He raised high: I mean Muḥammad.
My fortresses against enemies, the Fire and trial are my praise of him who removed harm, Aḥmad.
My ink and my pens are for my Lord and for the Prophet: with them I vie with those who made their striving sincere, praisers.
Whenever I return, as a servant, to praise and gratitude, He bestows the wishes; and the return never ceases to be more praiseworthy.
My supplication answer, Lord, through the Chosen, perpetually; and from me accept, Lord, my striving, (making it) more praiseworthy.
